generator.name: Hackerbot 3 role-play character
generator.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
generator.description:
Generates a chat-only Hackerbot 3 bot that plays a character in the scenario: an employee of a fictional company (IT lead, receptionist, manager), a witness, a client. The character is data, not code: a character file (JSON: persona, background facts, rules, chat messages and instructor-written Q/A pairs) or the same fields passed as inputs. Common questions get the character's own canned answers through the decision router; anything else goes to the LLM with a system prompt built from the persona, background and rules. The bot runs no attacks and holds no flags. Add one per character; run alongside the scenario's Hackerbot.
Pick a bundled character with character="name" (characters/*.json), point at your own with character_file="/path.json", or override single fields (nick, persona, facts_json, pairs_json, ...). {{placeholders}} in any text are filled from "facts" plus main_user (the scenario's first account).
